title: NAND decision-tree complexity
statement: On inputs $(x_1,x_2)\in\{-1,1\}^2$, define NAND to return $1$ if both coordinates are $-1$, and $-1$ otherwise. Its randomized decision-tree complexity, measured by the infimum of the worst-case expected number of queried coordinates among finite-seed, zero-error randomized decision trees, is $2$.
